evidence_required: Definitions of prefill and decode and the bounding resource of each.

marking.criterion: Prefill defined (all prompt tokens processed in parallel, produces the KV cache and the first token) and called compute-bound
Decode defined (one token per sequence per step, re-reads all weights and the KV cache) and called HBM-bandwidth-bound
Supports the claim with intensity or an ORION number (decode about 32 FLOP/B at batch 32 against machine balance about 295 FLOP/B)

title: Prefill and decode
